rows.hypothesis: Wrong-word false warnings come from greedy argmax spikes on phone-confusable consonants, while the written word still carries most of the summed CTC path mass. Veto a wrong-word warning when the written word's forced CTC score over the segment is within a small margin of the heard word's score; predict listener -4 and overall -4.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall +0 (needs -3 or better), listener +0 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-22: +0 (needs -1 or better)

rows.hypothesis: Two planted omissions are detected but charged to the neighbouring word (44:5 word 4 reported as word 5, 20:25 word 4 reported as word 5), giving one miss plus one false warning each. Deciding which word of the gap the heard segment belongs to by CTC forward score instead of greedy-string edit distance fixes both; predict listener -4 (2 false warnings and the 2 paired misses in listener/omitted_word/missed), overall -4.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall +0 (needs -3 or better), listener +0 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-22: +0 (needs -1 or better)

rows.hypothesis: Mid-session, a one-word mistake next to a look-alike phrase (بالنذر in 54:36, فاعلموا/واعلموا أنكم غير معجزي الله in 9:2-3) makes another verse fit better than the current position, so the tracker relocates and the mistake is never compared against its own text. Relocation should have to beat the best local-edit explanation at the current position (one omission, substitution, or a skip of 3 ayahs or fewer) by a margin before committing. Predict tracker -3, overall -3; the p33 26:222 win is speculative.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall +0 (needs -3 or better), tracker +0 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-22: +0 (needs -1 or better)

rows.hypothesis: Extra words said in the pause between ayahs fall between two per-ayah comparison windows, so no insertion state ever prices them. Extend the folded joint-additions fit across the seam so it covers the previous ayah's last word, the heard speech in the gap, and word 1 of the next ayah. Predict 6 of the 11 word-1 targets won, checker -5, overall -4.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall +0 (needs -3 or better), checker +0 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-22: +0 (needs -1 or better)

rows.hypothesis: The listener has learned an implicit Quran sequence prior from Quran-only training text, so it under-emits speech that does not continue the expected verse, such as words inserted at an ayah start or a name swapped in a refrain. Fine-tuning on spliced 'unfaithful' recitation with corrected transcripts and no new channel augmentation should fix this; predict listener -5 and overall -4, mostly from the 13 added-word misses.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall +0 (needs -3 or better), listener +0 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-22: +0 (needs -1 or better)

rows.hypothesis: Omission warnings are decided on a heard segment cut by greedy alignment, which can split the surviving word (p79: the رِى tail of صَدْرِى scored as لِى) or miss a word whose phonemes are still in the posteriors. Score each omission warning with nll over the whole stretch between the confident neighbouring anchors. Compare the full written text against every single-omission placement, place the omission on the best placement, and veto it when the full text wins. Predict listener -4 (p79 pair = 2, plus 2 of the 3 unpaired omission false warnings, speculative), overall -4.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall -1 (needs -3 or better), listener -1 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-303: +0 (needs -1 or better)

rows.hypothesis: Words added in the pause between two confidently matched words (10 of 13 listener added-word misses are at word 1) are lost because greedy argmax picks blank on frames where speech mass is spread over several phonemes. Re-decode only those gap frames when forcing them to blank costs more than 2x SUPPORT nats, and hand the recovered phonemes to the existing added-word rules; predict listener -4, overall -3.
rows.note: dropped by you: its builder reports the redecode was never wired; engine code unchanged

rows.hypothesis: Seam additions are decoded but their consonants are matched onto word 1, the previous word, or a nearby word as a second visit that repeat/restart tolerance accepts; accept an extra visit as a repeat only if its consonant skeleton fits that word under the existing held-sound rules, else send it to added-word confirmation. Predict 6 of 11 won, checker -5, overall -4.
rows.note: killed by its builder: Step 0 kill: 0 of 11 targets are an accepted repeat or restart with 2 or more supported consonant mismatches; the extra visits fit the short words they land on, so the skeleton gate would not fire. (measured: {"targets won": 0})

rows.hypothesis: Refrain name swaps (26:106/142/161 word 5) are missed because the greedy string is the only thing asked, and it collapses to the written name; score the anchored slot against the closed set of names its parallel verses use and emit the swap when one beats the written name by SUPPORT. Predict 4 of the 8 cluster misses won, listener -4, overall -4 (-6 if the p11/p45 spillover warnings also vanish, speculative).
rows.note: dropped by you: prophet names are too specific (overfitting to the specific cases)

rows.hypothesis: A brief lock loss right after a mistake turns its open warning to uncertain even when the tracker relocks just ahead in the same passage (p46 54:36:4, p66 9:3:21). Park open issues through the loss and resolve them against their own text if the relock continues the same passage in order. Predict tracker -2 and overall -3; the third win is speculative and must come from the step-0 census.
rows.note: gate on the branch: overall -1 (needs -3 or better), tracker -3 (needs +2 or better); without reader mp3quran-40: +0 (needs -1 or better); 3 incidents lost against 4 won

rows.hypothesis: Three added words (p10, p33, p79) are already decoded and suspected, but they fail the 10-nat support test because the shipped posteriors are a weak judge of presence. A small text-conditioned verifier, trained to answer whether this anchored stretch holds an extra word beyond the text, confirms them; predict listener -4, overall -3, with the fourth win speculative.
rows.note: killed by its builder: Held-out seam-matched AUC was 0.988, but the three phone targets scored -1.06, -2.87 and -5.34 and stayed unconfirmed. (measured: {"targets won": 0})

rows.hypothesis: Seam additions are lost because the checker judges them on the greedy string, where the inserted speech can be split into valid fragments of nearby short words. Replace that decision with a reference-biased lattice decode over the full posteriors that compares [written text with contiguous repeat or restart arcs only] against [written text plus one whole mushaf-lexicon word inserted at a word boundary]. Predict checker -3 and overall -3 (-5 if the listener-charged p10, p33 and p79 also flip, speculative).
rows.note: killed by its builder: The lattice confirmed none of the 8 seam targets, on listener evidence or on perfect oracle phonemes. (measured: {"targets won": 0})

Words added after a waqf pause are lost because the model's long left context makes it expect the next verse word, not because the audio is missing. Re-run the acoustic model on just the pause gap plus short padding, so it cannot see the verse, and pass any recovered phonemes to the existing added-word rules; predict listener -4, overall -3.; practice-only fold, exam not measured
